tasks.title: Native default
tasks.goal: Owner decision. Explicit repeatable and portable requests must be satisfied or refused; neither promises every device or shape.

tasks.title: Native policy
tasks.goal: Proposed default for bulk operations: select a target implementation within declared dtype, rounding and accuracy constraints. Native does not mean arbitrary fast math or silent precision loss.

tasks.title: Repeatable policy
tasks.goal: Require identical output bits for identical inputs and a declared execution envelope: algorithm, target, compiler/driver/library versions, workspace, streams and launch settings.

tasks.title: Portable policy
tasks.goal: Require identical bits across a named target/operation/dtype set. An unmet request raises an explained error; “best effort” is a diagnostic result, not a guarantee.

tasks.title: Batch case
tasks.goal: Compare one row alone and embedded in a larger batch; preserve its operands, reduction dimension and output mapping.

tasks.title: Padding case
tasks.goal: Mask extra lanes by validity. Specify NaNs and signed zero; do not assume adding numeric zero preserves every bit.

tasks.title: Layout case
tasks.goal: Compare equivalent contiguous and strided views, then tile/block choices. Distinguish a changed address mapping from changed values.

tasks.title: Empty mean
tasks.goal: Raise ZeroDivisionError before launch for host-known zero reduction extents; transport a checked dynamic empty-row failure to the next synchronization boundary and attribute its logical row instead of claiming NaN implements the agreed contract.

tasks.title: Division and shifts
tasks.goal: Current integer division by zero and oversized shifts return zero. Resolve this conflict with the Pythonic goal before documenting them as stable.

tasks.title: FMA boundary
tasks.goal: One rounding is not exact real arithmetic. Matching bits also requires equal formats, rounding and special-value behavior. Do not claim unconditional cross-target FMA equality.

tasks.title: Audit missing contracts
tasks.goal: The seven current entries are Apple exp10/log10/pow/tan/tanh and NVIDIA pow/tan. State composition, domain and special values; no finite universal bound is required where it is unjustified.

tasks.title: Measure independently
tasks.goal: Use high-precision or interval references with correct input conversion, exponent range and subnormal treatment. MPFR precision alone does not reproduce an IEEE format.

tasks.title: Fix acceptance criteria
tasks.goal: The current expected failures search documentation for a finite-bound pattern. Replace that premise with structured contract validation and separate numerical cases; never promote a sampled maximum to a universal guarantee.

tasks.title: Subnormal handling
tasks.goal: Record input and output flushing per operation/target. A portable requirement needs a preserving implementation or refusal; a native limitation needs a callout.

tasks.title: Compiler contract
tasks.goal: Represent accumulation dtype, contraction/reassociation permission, rounding/storage boundaries and required invariance in IR and inspection output. Reject contradictory options.

tasks.title: Dispatch contract
tasks.goal: Filter candidates by the requested contract before tuning. Include algorithm and numerical policy in cache keys and benchmark records; invalidate incompatible cached choices.

tasks.title: Opaque instructions
tasks.goal: Tensor-core and vendor-library internals may be only partly specified. Record documented versus recovered behavior; do not infer portable equality from the instruction name.

tasks.title: Bitwise cases
tasks.goal: Require exact bits for specified scalar/conversion semantics and admitted reproducible operations; spell out NaN payload and signed-zero treatment.

tasks.title: Native bulk cases
tasks.goal: Check validity, special values and declared error or residual requirements. Recover or inspect the chosen schedule when possible; avoid one loose global tolerance.

tasks.title: Flat settings
tasks.goal: Use StrEnum for one choice, Flag for independent requirements, and booleans for independent switches. Use IntFlag only where integer-mask interchange is needed; reject unknown bits. Python has no built-in StrFlag. Keep accumulator dtype on the operation. No global fast-math switch.

tasks.title: Freeze each launch
tasks.goal: Use existing scoped settings. Freeze the resolved contract before compilation/launch; include it in dispatch, autotuning and graph-cache identities. Async tasks retain their snapshot.

tasks.title: Resolve requirements
tasks.goal: Scopes override defaults; an explicit operation requirement cannot be silently weakened. Reject incompatible requirements. Report the realized algorithm and guarantee.

tasks.title: Bound repeatability
tasks.goal: Same input bits, shape and declared device/software/algorithm envelope. Pin workspace, tunings, stream assumptions and seeds; revalidate upgrades.

tasks.title: Bound portability
tasks.goal: Name operations, dtypes, targets and invariances. A fixed tree is insufficient when FMA, subnormals, math approximations or hardware accumulation differ. Unsupported requests raise TargetError.

tasks.title: Elementwise add
tasks.goal: Portable where rounding, subnormals and special values agree. Fused expressions need a contraction rule.

tasks.title: Reduction
tasks.goal: Repeatability may pin a tree. Tile/partition invariance needs a canonical logical tree or reproducible accumulator. Padding is not always neutral for NaNs or signed zero.

tasks.title: Tensor-core GEMM
tasks.goal: Native and fixed-envelope repeatability are useful. Portable bits may require a slower composed algorithm; opaque hardware steps are not a cross-generation guarantee.

tasks.title: Atomic scatter
tasks.goal: A seed does not fix floating addition order. Use ordered segmentation or reproducible accumulation. Racing non-atomic writes remain invalid.

tasks.title: Math and solvers
tasks.goal: Matching vendor accuracy does not imply equal bits. Portable transcendental functions need a shared algorithm. Repeated eigenvalues require residual/subspace comparisons, not equal eigenvectors.

tasks.title: Defaults and result type
tasks.goal: Retain f16/bf16→f32, f64→f64 and int8→i32 defaults; settle f32, output dtype and product precision explicitly.

tasks.title: numbers.integer
tasks.goal: Signed/unsigned widths, conversions, overflow and packed lanes.

tasks.title: numbers.floating
tasks.goal: Float, complex and low-precision descriptors; rounding and accumulator constraints. Storage does not imply arithmetic support.

tasks.title: string
tasks.goal: String/byte-view types, encoding, offsets and validity. Algorithms belong in krn.unicode.

tasks.title: tensor
tasks.goal: Shape, strides, memory space, mutability and ownership; distinguish host handles from register/shared values.

tasks.title: krn.math and krn.fast.math
tasks.goal: Same operation vocabulary; precise versus approximate semantics documented per operation. Determinism is independent.

tasks.title: krn.memory, krn.groups, krn.atomics
tasks.goal: Proposed homes for movement, collectives and atomic operations. Reconcile existing exports before adding aliases.

tasks.title: krn.runtime
tasks.goal: Keep the existing krn.profile facade. Separate runtime ownership, krn.asyncio, hardware discovery and profiling behind small public contracts.

tasks.title: krn.linalg, krn.quantization, krn.unicode
tasks.goal: Algorithms compose the same frontend. Reconcile krn.lib.linalg and root linalg; avoid competing solver APIs. Dense, sparse, solvers and contour can be submodules.

tasks.title: Retrieval and serving
tasks.goal: Keep retrieval and serving adapters outside core imports; use separate packages when dependencies or release cadence justify it, and let later Rust and JavaScript bindings reuse the compiler/runtime behind a narrow ABI where practical.

tasks.title: krn._internals

tasks.title: Shape checking

tasks.title: View cases
tasks.goal: Validate noncontiguous slices, transposes, shared aliases, in-register arrays and read-modify-write stores. Distinguish host view from device-to-host copy.

tasks.title: Data launchers
tasks.goal: Freeze common launcher shape, ownership and error contracts in M1, retaining existing adapters while scheduling new string and sparse implementations in M6 and M7.

tasks.title: Logical storage types
tasks.goal: Carry packed/narrow dtype metadata through host upload, device arguments and result conversion; uint32 storage alone is not a packed logical type.

tasks.title: Loop else
tasks.goal: Implement loop else with Python break and exhaustion semantics.

tasks.title: Loop exits
tasks.goal: Implement break and continue with correct nested-loop destinations and state updates.

tasks.title: Short circuits
tasks.goal: Preserve conditional evaluation and side effects for and/or expressions.

tasks.title: Pattern matching
tasks.goal: Admit typed supported pattern forms and explicitly reject unsupported capture patterns.

tasks.title: Loop conditions
tasks.goal: Recompute runtime loop conditions after each iteration without reusing stale captured values.

tasks.title: Values and helpers
tasks.goal: Support tuple/struct returns, unpacking, views, bounded comprehensions and static closures while distinguishing launch-planned result allocation from unsupported unbounded per-thread allocation.

tasks.title: Constants and mutation
tasks.goal: Keep constexpr distinct from runtime int; resolve -inf, temporary in-place operations and generic struct configuration.

tasks.title: Number protocols
tasks.goal: Register device numeric ABCs without permissive int/float inheritance; preserve type mismatch diagnostics and explicit conversion.

tasks.title: Escape hatch
tasks.goal: Design intrinsic registration and per-target lowering with typed operands, effects and honest capability checks. Add device async roles only after the separate execution model is settled.

tasks.title: Project scope
tasks.goal: Support Python 3.14 and 3.14t on admitted macOS/Linux configurations, adding each newer released minor after compatibility checks while retaining private internals, frozen values and no CLI.

tasks.title: Deferred annotations
tasks.goal: Resolve deferred annotations at the capture or specialization boundary, preserving forward references and source-mapped failures for unresolved names.

tasks.title: Standard modules
tasks.goal: Inventory krn.itertools, krn.functools, krn.operator, krn.hashlib and collection exports, retaining implemented names and recording unsupported kernel forms.

tasks.title: Stable semantic IR
tasks.goal: Keep dtype/shape/layout, effects, address spaces, synchronization and numerical requirements explicit. Target lowering must preserve them or explain refusal.

tasks.title: Compiler reuse review
tasks.goal: Compare CUDA Tile/MLIR, cuTile, CuTe DSL, FlyDSL, TileLang and Tilus against concrete gaps; check semantics, dependency cost and licenses before adoption.

tasks.title: Bounded comparison
tasks.goal: Compare one elementwise, reduction and matrix kernel through a candidate path. Measure cold JIT, dependency size, diagnostics, semantic fidelity and steady-state performance before adopting it.

tasks.title: Integration boundary
tasks.goal: Record what krn owns, what an upstream compiler supplies and how versions are tested. Prefer one useful adapter over a wholesale rewrite; a lowering pipeline does not automatically design parallel algorithms.

tasks.title: Compiler and execution
tasks.goal: Typed capture, automatic geometry, emulator and C/CUDA/Metal execution; HIP generation/compile checks; matrix lowering and explained refusals.

tasks.title: Barrier metadata
tasks.goal: Audit captured barrier effects and reject unsupported divergent participation.

tasks.title: Struct capture
tasks.goal: Repair struct/helper import capture using precise typed identities and source spans.

tasks.title: Cooperative admission
tasks.goal: Reject cooperative launches whose occupancy or target capability requirements cannot be satisfied.

tasks.title: Cache eviction
tasks.goal: Make cache eviction respect in-flight compilation and execution ownership.

tasks.title: Callback cases
tasks.goal: One callback failure cannot strand later subscribers; late subscription must observe a completed event.

tasks.title: Cancellation cases
tasks.goal: Cancel before launch, during execution and during drain; verify backpressure release and eventual cleanup.

tasks.title: Thread and stream cases
tasks.goal: Verify per-context/per-thread/per-stream ownership, cross-thread notification and free-threaded behavior.

tasks.title: Runtime and tooling
tasks.goal: Frozen values, device facts/detection, native loader, official CUDA bindings, nvmath integration, host errors/logging, awaitable events, graph/launch paths and CPU/CUDA caches.

tasks.title: Free threading
tasks.goal: Support Python 3.14 and 3.14t first, testing GIL state after enabled bindings load and simultaneous compilation, configuration, cache access, launches, callbacks and teardown.

tasks.title: Python support
tasks.goal: Admit each newer released Python minor only after its installation and compatibility lanes pass; keep the current Python restriction until those results exist.

tasks.title: Lazy imports
tasks.goal: Import optional backends only on demand without hiding missing dependencies or turning a successful CPU import into a GPU support claim.

tasks.title: Explicit output writes
tasks.goal: First support y[i] = x[i] + 2 into an allocated result and return y. Scalar-return lifting is a later convenience only when the domain and unique writer are unambiguous.

tasks.title: Preserve Python return
tasks.goal: Do not make return inside an ordinary loop mean emit every iteration. Choose whole-tensor expressions or an explicit mapped invocation before syntax design.

tasks.title: Infer output metadata
tasks.goal: Infer axes, broadcasting, dtype, layout and device before launch. Require hints when ambiguous; branch results must unify.

tasks.title: Allocate once
tasks.goal: Proposed krn.memory.empty(shape, dtype, space=krn.Space.GLOBAL) declares one owned output allocation per launch. Infer metadata from input shapes and the result annotation; reject contradictions. Hoist allocation to the launcher. Shared/register scratch cannot escape.

tasks.title: Return tuples and reductions
tasks.goal: Start with typed tuples; track allocations/aliases separately. Decide that reduction scalars stay on device by default to avoid hidden synchronization.

tasks.title: Allocation vocabulary
tasks.goal: Use krn.memory.empty for storage and krn.memory.array for initialization. Specify copy versus view semantics. krn.global.array is invalid Python syntax.

tasks.title: Async initialization
tasks.goal: Specify copy completion and buffer ownership in M1, with asynchronous loading implementation deferred to M5 after events and lifetime contracts pass.

tasks.title: Reuse buffers
tasks.goal: Free after all consumers through stream ordering or events. Validate explicit out shape, dtype, device, strides and alias rules.

tasks.title: Protect retained graph outputs
tasks.goal: A previous result must not silently change during replay. Choose owned results, explicit borrowed buffers or rejected concurrency.

tasks.title: Handle data-dependent shapes
tasks.goal: Define capacity-plus-length results and bounds in M1, deferring prefix-sum allocation implementations until M2 scan primitives and the relevant domain contracts exist.

tasks.title: Acceptance cases
tasks.goal: Elementwise, broadcast, row reduction, tuples, zero size, strided input, aliasing, out reuse, concurrent streams, cancellation and graph replay. Verify allocation/transfer counts.

tasks.title: Output spaces
tasks.goal: Distinguish owned global outputs from nonescaping register and shared scratch before planning result allocation.

tasks.title: Numerical foundations
tasks.goal: Strict scalar flags, explicit FMA, conversions, fast/strict separation, narrow conversions, raw SIMD intrinsics and tested noftz global add.

tasks.title: Recorded fixes
tasks.goal: Ragged mean, Metal GELU, explicit FMA fallback loops, once-per-site warnings and dispatcher operand evaluation fixes were implemented; integrated checks remain due.

tasks.title: Scalar functions
tasks.goal: Define the typed arithmetic, comparisons, conversions, min/max, transcendental and domain-error surface with explicit unsupported cases.

tasks.title: Fast functions
tasks.goal: Give each krn.fast.math operation its own approximation and exceptional-value contract without a global fast-math switch.

tasks.title: Independent references
tasks.goal: Compare finite arithmetic and special cases against independent high-precision or exact references rather than treating the emulator as proof of itself.

tasks.title: Show real failures
tasks.goal: One invalid setting, unsupported target operation and unsupported kernel construct. Show expression, shape/dtype/target when useful and a remedy; avoid tensor dumps.

tasks.title: Retain launch origin
tasks.goal: Preserve kernel source, launch site, await/synchronize site, causes, notes and grouped failures.

tasks.title: Separate built from planned
tasks.goal: Host reconstruction exists; compiling kernel raise/try/assert is unfinished. Synthetic records do not prove the device path.

tasks.title: Check meaningful rendering
tasks.goal: Source spans, one chained failure and error-buffer overflow; avoid full ANSI snapshot suites.

tasks.title: Bounded transport
tasks.goal: Implement source-site tables and device log/error records for CPU, CUDA and Metal. Count overflow and deliver after completion; never silently lose an error.

tasks.title: Checked assertions
tasks.goal: Lower checked assertions to bounded source-mapped exception records.

tasks.title: Checked raises
tasks.goal: Lower supported explicit raises with typed payload and deferred host exception delivery.

tasks.title: Exception regions
tasks.goal: Represent exception regions and cleanup effects in typed IR before lowering handlers.

tasks.title: Exception handlers
tasks.goal: Implement admitted try/except/else/finally forms with cleanup and control-flow tests, rejecting each unsupported form explicitly.

tasks.title: Exception identity
tasks.goal: Rebuild the same Python exception class with source/thread notes. Choose grouped failures versus first failure; use BaseExceptionGroup where non-Exception subclasses require it.

tasks.title: Uniform exits
tasks.goal: Reject or safely coordinate error paths that would strand other participants at a barrier.

tasks.title: Required cases
tasks.goal: Empty mean, integer divide-by-zero decision, invalid access, multiple failing lanes, caught/rethrown errors and finally cleanup.

tasks.title: Debug workflow
tasks.goal: Record source identity, logical index and launch context in M1 exceptions, leaving interactive inspection and breakpoint helpers to M3.

tasks.title: Public logging
tasks.goal: Use standard Python logging with structured kernel, launch and target context and choose the public krn.log facade without exposing private runtime objects.

tasks.title: Bounded diagnostics
tasks.goal: Bound diagnostic buffers and deduplicate repeated messages while retaining severity, overflow counts and the original exception.

tasks.title: Safe context
tasks.goal: Exclude input tensor contents, tokens and paths not needed for diagnosis by default and allow explicit local debug context.

tasks.title: Separate status dimensions
tasks.goal: Represent implementation as native/composed/refused; evidence as declared/compile-tested/device-tested; result as pass/fail/skip/expected-failure. Preserve unknown and unavailable states.

tasks.title: Scope each cell
tasks.goal: Key by feature, dtype, shape/layout limits, memory scope, numerical policy, architecture and software versions. A successful CUDA compile is not a hardware result.

tasks.title: Make coverage honest
tasks.goal: Remove broad migration exclusions in stages. Publish full-package line/branch coverage, excluded scope and conformance separately; fix inconsistent applicable/pass totals.

tasks.title: Reconcile existing reports

tasks.goal: Tests currently default to avx512 and one Metal target. Detect compatible targets; mark ISA-specific cases. Exercise generic CPU kernels on x86 and Arm.
